content2.content: Setting up Firebase is the first step to integrating backend services into your Flutter app. This involves creating a project in the Firebase Console and configuring your Android and iOS apps.

content4.content: Go to the Firebase Console (console.firebase.google.com) and click 'Add project'. Follow the on-screen instructions to name your project and enable Google Analytics if desired.

content6.content: In the Firebase Console, click the Flutter icon to launch the setup workflow. This is the recommended way as it uses the FlutterFire CLI.
